title: Rotation Station
description: At Tehachapi Pass in Kern County, California, towering wind turbines cast shadows across rolling hills. Known as the birthplace of North American wind energy, Tehachapi became home to some of the continent’s first large-scale wind farms in the early 1980s. Today, generations of turbines continue to turn side by side, capturing the evolution of wind power in a landscape shaped by the wind.
translated_description: 在加利福尼亚州克恩县的特哈查比山口，高耸的风力涡轮机在起伏的山丘上投下阴影。作为北美风能的发源地，特哈查比在20世纪80年代初成为北美大陆一些最早的大型风电场的所在地。如今，一代又一代的涡轮机继续并排转动，在被风塑造的地貌中捕捉着风电的演变。
